summary: Stereo 24-bit 192 kHz audio codec (ADC + DAC), single-ended analog in/out, I2S or left-justified serial audio; wired here in Software (I2C) Mode as an I2S slave at 7-bit address 0x48 (1001 + AD2..AD0 = 000). NEEDS A 5 V ANALOG SUPPLY: VA 4.75-5.25 V; VD 3.14-5.25 V and VLC 1.71-5.25 V run from +3V3. Channel A = left, B = right. Line in via a 2k/2k divider (2 Vrms to the 1 Vrms full scale) and 10 uF; line out via 3.3 uF, 10k and a 470 ohm / C filter; MUTEA/MUTEB (optional external mute) left open
